adjudication.rationale: Looking at packages/lib/CalendarService.ts in the diff, the createEvent method extracts `[mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` and uses it to filter calendars. This always selects the first destination calendar from the array, regardless of which credential is being used. In contrast, GoogleCalendarService.ts properly uses `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)` to match the destination calendar to the current credential. The BaseCalendarService doesn't receive or use a credentialId parameter to select the correct destination calendar, meaning for collective team events with multiple hosts, all calendar services extending BaseCalendarService would target the organizer's (first) calendar instead of each host's respective calendar.
